hack.root_cause: Unregistered NATIVE_BTC in SigmaSupplier → disabled supply cap → ETH-to-BTC 1:1 minting (infinite mint)
hack.description: Bedrock lost $2M when an unaudited uniBTC vault upgrade failed to register BTC as a native asset, letting anyone mint 1 uniBTC per 1 ETH deposited — a 20x price gift — across 8 chains.
